messages:
maya: Quick note: proposing a compact "policy snapshot" badge on rollout rows that captures fallback + reason + a tiny action menu. Keeps list dense but clickable.

 tom: Can you list exactly what should be in the badge? We want to avoid forcing people into the full detail panel for quick triage.

 maya: Badge fields (one-line): mode | trigger-summary | sample% | cost-delta | audit-id. Tapping expands a small popover with 'why' (causal trace), last matched metric, and actions: preview, open runbook, create incident.

 ralph: Important: badge must surface whether the view is a snapshot (evaluation-time) or live. Snapshots are critical for reproducible audits. Live badges can show a pulsing dot.

 policy-bot: policy-bot: eval_snapshot created: id=snap-20260322-11 policy=auto-fallback policy_version=v4.0 trigger=latency_p95(>800ms) sample=2% fallback=small-lm-x86 cost_delta=$0.12/1k tokens

 tom: UX nit: use microcopy "snapshot @ 2026-03-22T11:00Z" so people know exactly when policy matched. Also add a copy button for audit id.

 maya: Agreed. For the popover: show a 3-line causal chain: metric -> route -> matched-rule. And show a tiny timeline sparkline (30m) to give context. Keep it grayscale.

 sylvie: On actions: preview should run sampled requests through fallback in a sandboxed preview to show example outputs. We need permission checks to ensure only devs/operators can preview.

 ralph: For audit storage: store flattened blobs (strings only) with fields: policy_version, evaluation_ts, trigger_summary, fallback_variant, sample_pct, cost_estimate, quota_impact, operator_action_id (if any), input_ref (hash or pointer). TTL default 90d, aggregated indexes persisted long-term.

 maya: API sketch: GET /rollouts/{id}/snapshot/{snap_id} -> returns snapshot_id + flattened fields; POST /rollouts/{id}/actions {action, comment} -> returns action_id. Action must be logged to snapshot.audit_actions[].

 tom: Backend concerns: if we snapshot every evaluation and we have 50k/day * 1KB = 50MB/day. Fine but need to ensure we cap snapshots per-rollout to avoid runaway storage. Suggest keep 100 latest snapshots per rollout.

 policy-bot: telemetry: fallback_triggered audit=snap-20260322-11 pct=2 trigger=latency_p95 value=920ms

 sylvie: RBAC: preview -> role=can_preview; operator actions (escalate, rollback) -> role=operator. Every action returns action_id (act-YYYYMMDD-XXX) and is appended to snapshot.audit_actions with user id, timestamp, comment.

 maya: Small console UI mock (single line card):
```
Rollout: feature/short-text-svc  •  snapshot @2026-03-22T11:00Z
[SNAPSHOT] quiet-degrade | latency_p95>800ms | 2% | +$0.12/1k | audit:snap-20260322-11  ▸
```
Popover shows three rows of details + [Preview sample] [Open runbook] [Escalate].

 tom: Also include a "historical behavior" mini-chart in popover: avg fallback duration for similar triggers (last 90d) so oncall can estimate persistence.

 ralph: Security/compliance: include an input_ref pointer rather than raw input. If customer data required, store an access-controlled pointer and mask in the console.

 maya: Next steps: I'll add the mock images to the doc, sylvie will draft the RBAC matrix, tom will estimate snapshot retention/cap per rollout, ralph will prepare a recommended audit blob shape. Let's sync Friday 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC.

 policy-bot: calendar: meeting created by maya for 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC (30m) — "Policy snapshot badge sync"

 tom: Thanks, everyone. I'll prototype the popover interactions and share a small accessibility checklist.

 sylvie: I'll flag the preview action for review with legal before we enable customer-owned data in previews.

 maya: Awesome, will share the draft in design doc channel shortly. :rocket:
